crop_loss_claim.title: Crop Loss Compensation Claim

required_documents.label: Geo-tagged photo of the damaged crop

rules: Claim must be filed within 7 days of the loss event.
Name on land record, bank passbook and Aadhaar must match the applicant.
Loss below 33% is not eligible for compensation.

scholarship_post_matric.title: Post-Matric Scholarship

required_documents.label: Income certificate (valid for 12 months from issue)

rules: Application must be submitted on or before 31 Oct 2026.
Income certificate must not be expired on the date of submission.
Annual family income must not exceed 250000 INR.

ration_card_update.title: Ration Card Update

required_documents.label: Aadhaar card of the head of household

rules: Name on address proof must match the head of household on Aadhaar.
Existing ration card copy is mandatory for any update.
